QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`, so a struct declared as `ssl->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` is really `ssl->private_state`. ... With the define set, it expands to `member` and the name is the bare field.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both the default rename to private_<member> and the unchanged member name when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined.
